losses.description: Claims of sleepless nights, loss of appetite, great mental and physical harm and depression to the extent of disability: “經常澈夜難眠，寢食不安，精神和身體都受到極大傷害，不能再過正常人的生活，已患精神抑鬱症，達到 “傷殘” 程度。”
Plaintiff pleaded general damages for pain, suffering and loss of amenities and alleged he cannot lead a normal life due to depression.
